defs.meaning: 出租（rent 的三单形式）；租用

examples.en: She rents a house with three other girls.
examples.zh: 她和另外3个女孩合租了一套房子。

examples.en: They decided to let out the smaller offices at low rents.
examples.zh: 他们决定以低租金把那些较小的办公室租出去。

examples.en: They will have to pay much more when rents treble in January.
examples.zh: 房租1月份时将增加两倍，他们得付多得多的钱。
